verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no security documentation for this skills collection. Nothing covers what skills are permitted to execute, a trust model for third-party skills, or telemetry and data-collection practices. Statements about update control ("nothing updates behind your back", read-only plugin bundles) and MIT licensing are adjacent distribution details, not a documented security posture.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, the project documents its security posture — what skills can execute, the trust model for third-party skills, and any telemetry or data collection
